page: Method Not Allowed Middleware for HTTP 405 responses. Returns 405 Method Not Allowed response with Allow header when path matches but HTTP method not supported. Import: {Hono} from 'hono', {methodNotAllowed} from 'hono/method-not-allowed'. HTTP status: 405 Method Not Allowed (without middleware Hono returns 404 Not Found). HTTP header: Allow lists allowed methods. Options: app (required, Hono instance for route collection), onMethodNotAllowed (optional, custom handler). Handler signature: (c: Context, allowedMethods: string[]) => Response | Promise<Response>. Default behavior: 405 response with Allow header set from registered methods. Customization: override handler for JSON responses or custom formats. Difference: GET/HEAD/OPTIONS automatically included in Allow header. Questions: How to return 405 responses? sections.manifest: Import statements for Method Not Allowed middleware. import {Hono} from 'hono' for main framework. import {methodNotAllowed} from 'hono/method-not-allowed' for middleware function. Questions: What to import? Where is methodNotAllowed located?

Method Not Allowed middleware basic usage. app.use(methodNotAllowed({app})). Pass Hono instance as app option. Automatically detects allowed methods from registered routes. Example: app.get('/hello'), app.post('/hello') on same path. Request PUT /hello returns 405 Method Not Allowed. Response includes Allow header: 'Allow: GET, HEAD, POST'. Default response format: text 405 status. Custom response: onMethodNotAllowed: (c, methods) => c.json({error: 'Method Not Allowed'}, 405, {Allow: methods.join(', ')}). methods parameter is string[] array of allowed methods. Can customize status, headers, body. Supports async handlers (Promise<Response>). Questions: How to enable 405 responses? What's the app option? How to get allowed methods? How to customize response? Can I use JSON? What about async?

Method Not Allowed middleware options specification. Required: app (Hono instance, collects allowed methods from registered routes for each path). Optional: onMethodNotAllowed ((c: Context, allowedMethods: string[]) => Response | Promise<Response>, generates custom response including Allow header). Default behavior: returns 405 Method Not Allowed with Allow header set to registered methods. allowedMethods parameter: string[] array of HTTP methods allowed for that path. Can set Allow header manually with methods.join(', '). Default Allow header contains methods from registered routes plus HEAD if GET registered, plus OPTIONS. Questions: Which option required?
